title: I got tired of static AI images, so I built a browser RPG where every generated character is an animated video loop
author: lordwdk
selftext:
Hi fellow devs,

I’ve been working on **Webattle**, a browser-based monster tamer where the roster is entirely generated by players via text prompts.

My goal was to move beyond the typical "static AI card game" and try to create something that feels alive and playable immediately.

**Here is a breakdown of my current pipeline & mechanics:**

**1. The Asset Pipeline (Text -> Video):** Instead of just generating a static PNG, I'm using an image-to-video workflow.

* User inputs a prompt -> System generates a base pixel-art style image.
* That image is processed to create a **dynamic video loop**, giving the sprite idle animations.

**2. The Data Pipeline (Text -> JSON Stats):**

* The prompt is passed through an LLM to analyze semantics.
* It returns a JSON object with structured RPG stats (HP, Atk, Spd) based on the "vibe" of the prompt (e.g., "Turtle" = High Def).
* It also assigns a backstory and initial moveset.

**3. The Gameplay Loop (Making it a "Game"):** I didn't want it to just be a generator, so I built a full RPG loop around the assets:

* **Skill System:** A "Skill Wheel" mechanic (RNG) to let players roll for specific combat abilities (DoTs, Heals, Buffs).
* **Equipment:** Standard RPG inventory system to buff the generated stats.
* **Idle/AFK:** A newly added "Learning System" where the generated entities can gain XP via time-based tasks.

**Current Status:** It's live and playable in the browser (no download). I’ve also added localization for 5 languages (EN/JP/KR/ZH/AR) to test global latency.

**Link:**[https://webattle.ai](https://webattle.ai)

I’m looking for feedback specifically on the **prompt-to-stat balancing**. Has anyone here found a good way to normalize LLM outputs so players don't just generate "God Mode" characters every time?

Cheers!

comments.author: Touitoui
comments.body:
Love the style of the characters! The UI feels nice too.

Here are some feedback:  
  
Arena:  
\-It would be nice to use the "last selected" options (Have your default selection be your last selected mode and last selected character)  
\-"Skip battle" button would be useful, and wouldn't require much work since... Going back to the previous page works, ahah. "Speed up battle" would be a nice addition too.  
\-Random battles is bad. You can either get wrecked because you fight a high level enemy, or bully a low level one. Bullying a low level enemy also mean less xp  
\-No info on your rating in Ranked battles?  
I think it would be better if Random battle paired you with similar level enemies and Ranked battle paired you with similar rated enemies (Ranked mode would allow you to fight for the top, and potentially balance figths between characters with SSR equipments in the long run)  
  
Battle stats are currently broken:  
\-Arena's leaderboards seem to still be placeholders   
\--Arena's Win rate, Scriptgeist is first with 100% win, below characters shouldn't be in the top anymore  
\--Arena's Most battles: Scriptgeist has lost two battles (so win rate is technically incorrect AND it's card's recent battles show it has lost more than 2 battles, against myself included)  
\-Scriptgeist card show 0 win 1 loss, even if Recent battles shows it won/lost seveal battles   
In general, character's cards seem to have broken win/lose records. I looked at a few cards, and with the exception of certain cards showing a coherent win/lose ratio per level (around 24win/2lose, level 23, similar to my characters), most of the cards show 0-2 win/loss with lvl 20+ and recent battles being full.  
  
Training:  
\-I'm currently waiting to see the result... But having more informations on what to expect would be useful  
  
Skills:  
\-The wheel show a 8/8 before rolling - 7/8 after rolling, but no option to roll again  
\-Only two skills ? (Even with a lvl 40+ character, I never got to roll the skill wheel again)  
\-Not enough info on the skills   
The wheel show rarity, how does it impact the skill? Earning a skill show info like "attack"/"buff", but nothing show on the character's card? What is the number at the top-right corner?  
\-While I though the game didn't had sound yet... One of my character got a skill with sound!   
See [Umbra Siren](https://www.webattle.ai/pet/97e7b829-2ca9-425d-acf4-bc39daf2c9d9)'s Shadow Grasp

replies.author: Touitoui
replies.body:
Paid service:  
\-In general, it feel way too much pay to win!  
While bonus coins would technically not be too much of an issue (since you can earn them), it still feel unbalanced knowing that someone who take the most expensive subscription would have a huge amount of ssr equipements. But most importantly, since it raises the equipement limit, it mean that Masters can have OP characters, even compared to Elite members, "just because"  
\-The website shows "50% on yearly subscription", but the displayed price is only "2 months free"  
\-It would be nice to be able to reroll our character's image/video. Design reroll could be a nice incentive that wouldn't break the game's balance  
  
Profile:  
\-I connected with my google account and now my name is displayed... Would be nice to choose what my username is  
\-Total battles is broken, it shows "50 battles" but I have several character with 30+ battles  
  
It would be nice to have a page to see the list of existing cards (with filters using tags)  
  
Discord link is invalid

As for prompt-to-stat balancing, maybe doing it like how some gatcha usually do: every characters have the same number of stat points, and they are distributed according to the character's description?  
Higher quality could have more points,  
And on that same note, it could be nice if we could upgrade our character's quality (Arena rewards or something). It would be a shame having a card you love and having to dump it because it's only a normal, ahah

  
Well, that's it for now, keep up the good work !!

(I had to post my comment in two part, for some reason)

replies.author: Touitoui
replies.body:
Update: Got a few buddies that got a third skill (second wheel) but... I don't know why!  
  
One buddy is lvl 50 and had training, never lost : 2 skills  
Several buddies over lvl 30, no training, never lost: 2 skills  
One buddy was lvl 1, never fough, and came back from training lvl 18 with 2 wheels   
Two buddy around lvl 10, lost a few fights: 3 skills  
A buddy lvl 15, lost a few fight: 2 skills

... Am I missing something?
